sources.title: UK GDPR Article 5
sources.taken: collected (whether from the data subject or otherwise) for specified, explicit and legitimate purposes and not further processed by or on behalf of a controller in a manner that is incompatible with the purposes for which the controller collected the data
sources.note: Article 5(1)(b) and Article 5(1)(c) were read. Article 5(1)(e) now refers to Article 84B. Article 84B was not opened. Article 6 and Article 9 were not opened.

sources.title: Freedom of Information Act 2000, section 1
sources.taken: Any person making a request for information to a public authority is entitled to be informed in writing by the public authority whether it holds information of the description specified in the request, and if that is the case, to have that information communicated to him.
sources.note: Section 1(1) is the right of access. Section 1(2) says that right is subject to section 1 and to sections 2, 9, 12 and 14. Those sections were not opened. The page said there are currently no known outstanding effects for section 1.

sources.title: Employment practices and data protection: monitoring workers
sources.note: The hub says the guidance is under review because of the Data (Use and Access) Act and may change. This starter does not decide that monitoring workers is lawful.

sources.title: Specific data protection considerations for different ways or methods of monitoring workers
sources.note: The page says messages include instant messages and the chat functions in collaboration tools. It says a DPIA must be completed before monitoring emails and messages. It says content should be distinguished from network data, and that content is for exceptional circumstances with advance notice. This starter does not decide that a DPIA is required and does not complete one.

sources.title: List channel messages, Microsoft Graph v1.0
sources.note: GET /teams/{team-id}/channels/{channel-id}/messages returns messages without replies unless $expand=replies is used. Delegated least privilege on that page is ChannelMessage.Read.All. Application least privilege is ChannelMessage.Read.Group, which uses resource-specific consent. Personal Microsoft accounts are not supported. $top and $expand are the supported query options. A date filter is not a supported query option on that page. This starter does not call Graph.

sources.title: Harnesses in Copilot Studio
sources.note: The standard harness follows the topics and rules the maker defines. The GitHub Copilot harness is a Copilot Studio framework, not the GitHub Copilot service. Agents on it use Copilot Credits. The page states no price.

sources.title: Overview of AI in Microsoft Teams
sources.note: Copilot in Teams chats and channels is described as helping a user catch up. The linked end-user article was not opened. Channel Agent is described as a channel collaboration agent. The overview table lists an article about creating and sending emails with Channel Agent. That article was not opened. This starter does not use Channel Agent and does not send.
